articles.summary: Phoenix Education Partners, Inc. (NYSE: PXED), the parent company of University of Phoenix, today announced it will host a conference call on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. MST (5:00 p.m. EST) to discuss its results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year ended August 31, 2026. Financial results will be released the same day after the market close. The call can be accessed by webcast on the Phoenix Education Partners website at www.phoenixeducationpartners.com . Please register in the Investor Relations section of the site 15 minutes prior to the call. The call can also be accessed by dialing (833) 461-5787 (North America toll-free) or +1 (585) 542-9983 (International), using Meeting ID: 499741507. The webcast will be archived for 30 days and the call replay for seven days. To access the replay, dial (833) 309-1852 (toll-free), using Meeting ID: 499741507, or visit the Investor Relations section of the Phoenix Education Partners website . About Phoenix Education Partners, Inc.
articles.title: Phoenix Education Partners Schedules Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Earnings Conference Call
